peercraft.session.title: PeerCraft session

peercraft.session.hosts: Who would make a better host?

peercraft.session.status.world: World ticks exceed the 50 ms budget
peercraft.session.status.network: Some players have high ping to the host
peercraft.session.overview.hint: Open a section for measurements and explanations.
peercraft.session.network.source: Source: player latency reported by Minecraft. Each value measures a player’s connection to the server, not connections between all participants.
peercraft.session.network.unknown: Ping variation, packet loss, send queue and transfer speed are not measured yet.
peercraft.session.network.advice: For unstable connections, check Wi-Fi or a wired connection and compare hosts. If files are being sent, try limiting upload.
peercraft.session.world.explain: At the usual 20 ticks per second, each tick must finish within 50 ms. This is average processing time, excluding the wait between ticks.
peercraft.session.world.advice: Try lowering the chunk loading distance in Minecraft settings.
peercraft.session.world.no_advice: An average alone cannot rule out occasional world stalls.
peercraft.session.world.remote_detail: Tick time is read on the host computer only. Sharing this measurement with guests is not connected yet.
peercraft.session.files.unknown: Transfer counters are not connected yet. Missing measurements do not mean there are no transfers.
peercraft.session.files.explain: Mod downloads and world transfers can compete with game traffic.
peercraft.session.files.advice: Compare the connection after a download completes. The cause remains a hypothesis until queue and speed measurements are available.
peercraft.session.players.explain: Each participant’s latency to the current server. Tab shows these values instead of bars.
peercraft.session.hosts.explain: A host needs enough performance for the world and stable connections to the other participants.
peercraft.session.hosts.unavailable: Connection testing between participants is not connected yet. No reliable host ranking is available.
peercraft.session.hosts.world: This world has not been benchmarked on another computer. Current ping alone cannot identify the best host.
peercraft.session.hosts.manual: Hosting is handed off manually with separate confirmation. Opening this screen never starts a handoff.
peercraft.telemetry.title: Help improve PeerCraft
peercraft.telemetry.body: Allow technical statistics to be sent to the PeerCraft server? Mod, game, loader and Java versions, OS family, connection results and timing, Mod Sync errors and disconnects help find problems. No usernames, chat, mod lists or world contents. You can change this in PeerCraft settings.
peercraft.gui.settings.telemetry_desc: Send environment versions, connection results and timing, Mod Sync and disconnect error codes. No usernames, chat or world contents. Turning this off immediately stops sending and clears the queue.
peercraft.session.metric.probes: Connection probes · rolling window of 30 results

peercraft.session.metric.queue_note: Queue is data waiting inside PeerCraft, excluding OS buffers. Probe timeout: 3 s. Loss includes delayed replies.
peercraft.session.metric.world_local: Measured on this computer. A tick budget is 50 ms.
peercraft.session.metric.world_remote: The host reports this measurement every second.
peercraft.session.metric.file_advice: If game latency rises during transfers, limit upload on the sending computer.

peercraft.session.metric.test_intro: Run the comparison with all players online. Results expire when participants change.
peercraft.session.metric.estimate_note: World tick forecast uses a common CPU sample and the current host tick. It is an estimate, not a world replay.
peercraft.session.metric.rank: Worst link: %s ms · estimated world tick: %s ms
peercraft.session.metric.ineligible: Unavailable for handoff: account or successor preference.
peercraft.session.metric.incomplete: Insufficient data: complete connection tests and CPU sample first.
peercraft.session.metric.no_auto_handoff: No automatic host changes. Lower delay and a tick below 50 ms are preferable.
